title: Hoodlum Soldier Ep 9: The Cursed Road

scenes.say: The roads of Fallujah. The squad moves in Humvees. Nervous tension.
scenes.visual: a line of Humvees on a dusty road in Fallujah, cinematic film still, moody color grade, no text

scenes.say: Roddy: Why this road always feel cursed?
scenes.visual: inside a Humvee, soldiers in helmets, tense, cinematic film still, moody color grade, no text
an explosion of dust and fire on a desert road, cinematic film still, moody color grade, no text

scenes.say: Ali wakes up dazed, blood on his forehead. Screams echo.
scenes.visual: smoke and wreckage on a road, blurred figures, cinematic film still, moody color grade, no text

scenes.say: Q: We got casualties! Ali crawls out of the wreckage. Dazed, but alive.
scenes.visual: a soldier crawling out of a damaged vehicle, smoke, cinematic film still, moody color grade, no text
a field medical tent with a bandaged soldier on a cot, cinematic film still, moody color grade, no text

scenes.say: Flores: That's your second close call. Ali: Death don't want me yet. Doc: You too stubborn.
scenes.visual: soldiers around a cot in a medical tent, faces turned away, cinematic film still, moody color grade, no text

scenes.say: Psych eval. Trouble sleeping? Flashbacks? Only when I close my eyes.
scenes.visual: a soldier sitting across from a desk in a stark office, cinematic film still, moody color grade, no text

scenes.say: You may be showing early signs of PTSD. Ali nods. Says nothing.
scenes.visual: a clipboard on a desk under fluorescent light, cinematic film still, moody color grade, no text

scenes.say: They knew it. And sent us back anyway.
scenes.visual: a soldier walking back toward the trucks, seen from behind, cinematic film still, moody color grade, no text

scenes.say: Follow for Episode Ten. Turn negative into positive.
scenes.visual: a dusty road stretching to the horizon at dusk, cinematic film still, moody color grade, no text

caption: HOODLUM SOLDIER, Episode 9 of 25: The Cursed Road. From the screenplay by Elvin Torres Sr. New episode every 48 hours.
